# Teravora

> Teravora is an India-based environmental and social risk practice — IFC
> Performance Standards implementation advisory, Equator Principles advisory, and
> ESG due diligence (Desktop and Site-Based ESDD), alongside carbon and climate,
> tailor-made ESG/sustainability training, and India's BRSR assurance readiness —
> with the method shown, not just the result. Teravora is a new India brand built
> on the advisory backbone of its parent practice, Teravue.

## What Teravora does
- All Solutions (the full service catalog): https://teravora.in/solutions
- Environmental & Social Due Diligence (IFC Performance Standards & Equator Principles advisory; Desktop and Site-Based ESDD): https://teravora.in/solutions/environmental-social-due-diligence
- Capacity Building & Training (tailor-made corporate and on-field training on environment, ESG, climate change and sustainability): https://teravora.in/solutions/capacity-building-esg-training
- Carbon & Climate (GHG inventory including Scope 3 across all 15 categories, decarbonization pathways, TCFD / IFRS S2 disclosure): https://teravora.in/solutions/carbon-climate
- ESG & Climate Strategy Advisory (materiality, governance, board-approvable ESG roadmaps): https://teravora.in/solutions/esg-climate-strategy-advisory
- Technical & Environmental Services (energy/water/waste audits, LCA, EIA/ESIA, ISO/IMS implementation): https://teravora.in/solutions/technical-environmental-services
- Sustainable Finance & Carbon Markets (green-finance readiness, ESG-ratings support, carbon-markets guidance): https://teravora.in/solutions/sustainable-finance-carbon-markets
- ESG Disclosure & Assurance Readiness (BRSR and BRSR-Core, prepared for reasonable assurance): https://teravora.in/solutions/esg-disclosure-assurance-readiness

## How Teravora proves its work
- Method and standards (Assess → Comply → Improve → Prove): https://teravora.in/how-we-prove

## Key facts (India ESG context)
- BRSR = Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report; mandatory for the top 1,000 listed companies since FY2022-23.
- BRSR-Core = the assured subset: 49 KPIs across 9 attributes.
- Reasonable assurance phase-in: top 150 (FY2023-24) → top 250 (FY2024-25) → top 500 (FY2025-26) → top 1,000 (FY2026-27).
